title: Code Search Status Updates
description: The code search doesn't update status without refreshing. This made it confusing when I searched, and nothing was happening on the screen (the search button was just stuck disabled). Really, it had started rebuilding, but didn't update till I refreshed and it was at 22%

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Completed the live-update and results UX pass in `MemorySmith.App/Components/Pages/CodeSearch.razor`. Status polling now refreshes while active search/index work is running, the results surface now uses a sidebar + detail card layout, snippet/file copy actions are explicit, snippet expansion loads wider line context, and the limit control now reflects the real operator cap from `MemorySmith:CodeSearch:MaxResults` instead of silently truncating at the old default of 10.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: 2026-08-08 deep-dive found CodeSearch.razor launches startup indexing as abandoned fire-and-forget and does not refresh/surface persisted LastError after failure. Backend status exists; UI lifecycle propagation remains incomplete and should be covered by the related observability task.
